name: Insurance Reports
query:
SELECT
  si.patient AS "PID",
  si.patient_name AS "Patient Name:data:170",
  si.name AS "Name:Link/Sales Invoice",
  si.insurance AS "Insurance:Data:200",
  si.grand_total AS "Outstanding:Currency:170"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE
  si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.status IN ('Unpaid','Overdue','Partly Paid')
  AND si.is_insurance = 1
  AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from)s AND %(to)s
ORDER BY si.outstanding_amount DESC;
